source.policy: Source names and original concise cues only; no full entries are emitted.

scope: Direct feat reaction/opportunity-attack rules. Spell grants retain their own casting controls. Source printings are separate records.

records.name: Delicious Pain
records.detail: Reaction immediately after taking Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage: gain Resistance to those types until your next turn.

records.name: Vampire Hunter
records.detail: Reaction on Necrotic damage: reduce it by {PB}d6.

records.name: Arcane Omens
records.detail: Reaction: you or a creature you see within 30 ft fails a save; add 1d4 to that save.

records.name: Divination Adept
records.detail: Reaction: a creature you see within 60 ft makes a D20 Test; give that roll Advantage or Disadvantage.

records.name: Elemental Familiar
records.detail: Your Bonus Action commands a familiar within 120 ft to use its Reaction for Energy Pulse: a 5-ft Emanation, DEX save against your familiar spell DC, 2d4 chosen-type damage and Prone for Medium/smaller targets on failure.

records.name: Transmuted Anatomy
records.detail: Reaction on a failed CON save: add 1d4, possibly turning it into a success.

records.name: Warlike Familiar
records.detail: Your familiar uses its Reaction when someone within 5 ft is hit: add your PB to that target’s AC against the attack. This does not spend your Reaction.

records.name: Fury of the Frost Giant

pool.label: Fury of the Frost Giant reaction

records.detail: Reaction: a creature you see within 30 ft hits and damages you; CON DC {DC}. Failure deals 1d8 + {PB} Cold and sets Speed to 0 until its next turn ends.

records.name: Guile of the Cloud Giant

pool.label: Guile of the Cloud Giant reaction

records.detail: Reaction: a creature you see hits you; resist that attack’s damage, then teleport up to 30 ft to a visible empty space.

records.name: Vigor of the Hill Giant
records.detail: Reaction: an effect would move you at least 5 ft or knock you Prone; prevent that movement and Prone.

records.name: Adept of the White Robes
records.detail: Reaction: you or someone you see within 30 ft takes damage; spend a spell slot and reduce it by slot-level d6 + your spellcasting modifier. Apply the slot cost separately.

records.name: Knight of the Crown
records.detail: Your Bonus Action commands an ally within 30 ft that can see or hear you: it can use its Reaction for one weapon attack, adding 1d8 damage on a hit. Your command has a PB-per-Long-Rest allowance.

records.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
records.detail: Reaction on a failed CON save: add 1d4, possibly turning it into a success.

records.name: Greater Mark of Handling
records.detail: While mounted, after your melee hit within 5 ft of the mount, the mount can use its Reaction to move its Speed or make one attack.

records.name: Greater Mark of Passage
records.detail: Your slot-free Magical Passage can let up to two willing visible creatures within 30 ft use their Reactions to teleport up to 30 ft to visible empty spaces.

records.name: Greater Mark of Sentinel
records.detail: When you use Mark of Sentinel’s Vigilant Guardian, one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike can join that same Reaction.

records.name: Greater Mark of Warding
records.detail: Reaction: an attack targets you or someone you see within 30 ft; impose Disadvantage on that roll.

records.name: Mark of Sentinel
records.detail: Reaction: someone you see within 5 ft is hit; swap places and take the hit instead.

records.name: Boon of Terror
records.detail: Reaction: a Frightened creature you see starts its turn within 60 ft without Total Cover; WIS DC {CHADC}. Failure forces it to spend its turn moving away as fast as possible.

records.name: Boon of the Soul Drinker

pool.label: Boon of the Soul Drinker reaction

records.detail: Reaction: an enemy within 120 ft reaches 0 HP; regain 50 HP. Apply healing separately.

records.name: Emerald Enclave Fledgling
records.detail: The Help-action position swap does not provoke opportunity attacks; it is not a Reaction.

records.name: Lordly Resolve
records.detail: Your Bonus Action lets up to three targets within 60 ft that see you use their Reactions to stand if Speed is not 0. The ensuing protective benefits last up to 1 minute.

records.name: Mythal Touched
records.detail: Reaction when a spell attack hits you or you fail a spell save: roll on the Mythal-Touched Magic table. Required saves use DC {DC}.

records.name: Tyro of the Gauntlet
records.detail: Reaction: an ally within 5 ft would be pushed or pulled; prevent it, provided the ally is not Incapacitated.

records.name: Zhentarim Ruffian
records.detail: Opportunity attack damage: roll the damage dice twice and choose either result. This changes damage; it does not grant an additional Reaction.

records.name: Zhentarim Tactics
records.detail: Reaction immediately after a creature within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack: make an opportunity attack against it.

records.name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
records.detail: Reaction on Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison damage: gain Resistance to that damage instance. This reaction allowance is separate from the once-per-Long-Rest weapon infusion.

records.name: Gift of the Gem Dragon

pool.label: Gift of the Gem Dragon reaction

records.detail: Reaction: take damage from a creature within 10 ft; STR DC {DC}. It takes 2d8 Force and a push up to 10 ft on failure; half damage and no push on success.

records.name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon

pool.label: Gift of the Metallic Dragon reaction

records.detail: Reaction: you or someone you see within 5 ft is hit; add {PB} AC against that attack.

records.name: Defensive Duelist
records.detail: Reaction on a melee hit against you: while wielding a proficient Finesse weapon, add {PB} AC against that attack only.

records.name: Mage Slayer
records.detail: Reaction: when a creature within 5 ft casts a spell, make a melee weapon attack against it. This is not an opportunity attack.

records.name: Mobile
records.detail: After your melee attack against a creature, it cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of that turn.

records.name: Polearm Master
records.detail: Reaction: an enemy entering your glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff or spear reach provokes an opportunity attack.

records.name: Sentinel
records.detail: Reaction: when a creature within 5 ft attacks someone else without Sentinel, make a melee weapon attack. This attack is not an opportunity attack. Your opportunity hits set Speed to 0 this turn, and Disengage does not prevent your opportunity attacks.

records.name: Shield Master
records.detail: Reaction after a successful DEX save for half damage: while holding a shield, take no damage instead.

records.name: War Caster
records.detail: Reaction: replace an opportunity attack caused by hostile movement with a one-action spell targeting only that creature. Check spell access, components and slot cost.

records.name: Gathered Whispers
records.detail: Reaction when an attack hits you: add {PB} AC against that attack.

records.name: Mist Walker
records.detail: Reaction on damage or a failed save against Grappled/Restrained: teleport up to 15 ft to a visible empty space.

records.name: Survivor
records.detail: Reaction on a failed save against Charmed/Frightened: add {PB} to the save.

records.name: Symbiotic Being
records.detail: Reaction on a failed save: expend a Hit Die, roll it and add the result to that save. Record the spent Hit Die separately.

records.name: Righteous Heritor
records.detail: Reaction: you or a creature within 30 ft takes damage; reduce it by 1d10 + {PB}.

records.name: Strixhaven Mascot
records.detail: During your Attack action, give up one attack so your mascot familiar can use its Reaction for one attack.

records.name: Bountiful Luck
records.detail: Reaction: an ally you see within 30 ft rolls a natural 1 on an attack, check or save; let it reroll and keep the new result. Your racial Lucky trait is unavailable before the end of your next turn.

records.name: Fade Away
records.detail: Reaction immediately after taking damage: become Invisible until your next turn ends or you attack, deal damage or force a save.

records.name: Orcish Fury
records.detail: Reaction immediately after using Relentless Endurance: make one weapon attack. This does not grant another use of that racial trait.

records.name: Second Chance
records.detail: Reaction: a creature you see hits you; force an attack reroll. Recover on initiative, Short Rest or Long Rest.

records.name: Boon of Energy Resistance
records.detail: Reaction on damage of either chosen resistance type: redirect toward a visible creature within 60 ft without Total Cover. DEX DC {CONDC}; failure deals 2d12 + {CON} of the triggering type.

records.name: Boon of the Night Spirit
records.detail: Taking a Reaction ends the Invisibility granted by Merge with Shadows. This does not grant a new Reaction.

records.name: Defensive Duelist
records.detail: Reaction on a melee hit against you while holding a Finesse weapon: add {PB} AC against melee attacks until your next turn.

records.name: Interception
records.detail: Reaction: a creature you see hits someone else within 5 ft; reduce that damage by 1d10 + {PB}. Hold a shield or Simple/Martial weapon.

records.name: Mage Slayer
records.detail: The revised feat does not grant the legacy spellcasting-triggered reaction attack.

records.name: Polearm Master
records.detail: Reaction: a creature enters your quarterstaff, spear or Heavy + Reach weapon’s reach; make one melee attack. Reactive Strike is not an opportunity attack.

records.name: Protection
records.detail: Reaction: an enemy you see attacks someone else within 5 ft. With a shield, impose Disadvantage on that attack and further attacks against the target until your next turn while you stay within 5 ft.

records.name: Sentinel
records.detail: Reaction: a creature within 5 ft Disengages or hits someone else; make an opportunity attack. An opportunity hit sets its Speed to 0 for this turn.

records.name: Shield Master
records.detail: Reaction after a successful DEX save for half damage: while holding a shield, take no damage instead.

records.name: Speedy
records.detail: Opportunity attacks against you have Disadvantage. This does not grant you a Reaction.

records.name: War Caster
records.detail: Reaction: when a creature provokes an opportunity attack by leaving your reach, cast a one-action spell targeting only it instead. Check spell access, components and slot cost.
